entities.name: Ignatius Knoblecher
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ignatius Knoblecher, also known by his Arabian nickname Abuna Soliman, was a Slovene Roman Catholic missionary in Eastern North Africa. He was one of the first explorers of the White Nile basin.
